frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes DURATIVE STAYING / SETTLED RESIDENCE — the notion of abiding, lodging, or taking up (and remaining in) occupancy of a place. Its invariant is the act of remaining-resident somewhere, not merely being located there momentarily; what derives from it is either the place-of-such-staying or the one-who-so-stays.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes DURATIVE STAYING / SETTLED RESIDENCE — the notion of abiding, lodging, or taking up (and remaining in) occupancy of a place. Its invariant is the act of remaining-resident somewhere, not merely being located there momentarily; what derives from it is either the place-of-such-staying or the one-who-so-stays.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every occurrence is nominal (form_inventory: N ×14) and every token but one is the ism-makān مَثْوَى ("place of staying/abiding, lodging, abode"); the single non-مَثْوَى token is the active participle ثَاوِيًا "one residing/dwelling" (28:45). Subtracting those morphological wrappers leaves one shared verbal kernel: to stay/reside/lodge in a place over time. Concrete evidence across families: (1) NARRATIVE/LODGING family — 12:21 "أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ" (make honorable his lodging/place-of-stay, of Joseph taken into the Egyptian's house) and 12:23 "أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَاىَ" (he made good my residence/lodging); here مَثْوَى is the domestic place where one is settled to stay. (2) PARTICIPLE family — 28:45 "وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ" (you were not a resident/dweller among the people of Midyan): pure durative residence with no place-noun morphology, exposing the verbal residue "to reside" directly. (3) ESCHATOLOGICAL family (the large cluster: 16:29; 29:68; 39:32; 39:60; 39:72; 3:151; 40:76; 41:24; 47:12; 6:128; and the general 47:19) — Hell/the Fire as "مَثْوَى" of the arrogant/wrongdoers/disbelievers, i.e. the place where they permanently reside; this is reinforced construction-internally by the recurring "خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا" (abiding therein) in 16:29, 39:72, 40:76, 6:128, which spells out precisely the staying/remaining that مَثْوَى names as a locus. Whether the stay is honorable lodging (Joseph), neutral residence (Midyan, "مَثْوَىٰكُمْ" 47:19) or dreadful eternal confinement (Hell), the root residue is identical: settled remaining-in-place.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: (a) FORM: 13 tokens are the maf'al ism-makān مَثْوَى = "place where [X] happens"; 1 token is the fā'il participle ثَاوٍ = "one who [X]s." Removing the "place-of" / "agent-of" morphology yields the bare verbal notion X = to stay/reside/abide. (b) CONSTRUCTION: two frames — iḍāfa (مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ / ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ, the residence OF the arrogant) and li- + dweller (مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ / لَّهُمْ, an abode FOR them); the genitive/li- supplies only the resident-party assignment ("whose place of stay"), not the staying notion itself, which is already in the root. The evaluative valence (بِئْسَ / أَكْرِمِى / أَحْسَنَ) is supplied lexically by those governing words, NOT by vwy. (c) PARTICIPANTS: Joseph, the Prophet, the arrogant/wrongdoers/disbelievers, addressed "you(pl)" — all interchangeable; the residue is participant-neutral. (d) CONTEXT: legal-narrative (household lodging), biographical (Midyan), eschatological (Hell) — context fixes WHERE and WITH-WHAT-VALENCE one stays, but the staying/residence itself is constant. After all four subtractions, only "durative settled residence" remains.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The hardest cases are 12:21 "أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ" and 12:23 "أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَاىَ," where مَثْوَى can be felt as "treatment/hospitality" rather than a physical spot, which risks drifting the root toward an abstract "manner of reception." It reconciles cleanly: even there مَثْوَى denotes the place-and-conditions of Joseph's staying in the household (he was literally settled to reside there — "عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًا"), so the residue "settled residence/lodging" is intact; "honor his lodging" = treat-well the residence in which he abides. The abstraction is an extension of, not a departure from, durative residence, and it stays within the same morphological form as the eschatological tokens, so no separate sense is needed.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The strongest alternative is a purely LOCATIVE core: "place/abode" with no durative component (i.e. vwy = generic dwelling-place). Internal evidence arbitrates AGAINST emptying out the staying-nuance: (i) 28:45 ثَاوِيًا is a participle, not a place-noun, and can only mean "residing/dwelling" — a bare "place" gloss cannot cover it; (ii) the eschatological tokens are repeatedly co-specified by خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ("abiding eternally therein," 16:29/39:72/40:76/6:128), showing the intended nuance is remaining/staying, not mere spatial location; (iii) in 3:151 مَثْوَى stands alongside مَأْوَى ("وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ"), a deliberate pairing that would be redundant if vwy meant only "place/abode." The durative-residence reading is therefore internally preferred over the flat locative one.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: (1) Awy/أوي (مَأْوَى) = refuge/resort — taking oneself TO a place for shelter; its vector is directional/protective, whereas vwy's مَثْوَى is the state of REMAINING settled once there. Their explicit co-occurrence in 3:151 (مَأْوَى then مَثْوَى) confirms the contrast is real and root-borne. (2) skn/سكن (مَسْكَن) = dwelling with tranquil settling/inhabitation. (3) xld/خلد (خُلْد, خَالِدِينَ) = perpetuity/duration itself — which in the Hell verses OPERATES ON مَثْوَى, showing they are distinct layers (xld = how long, vwy = the fact of residing). (4) nzl/نزل (مَنْزِل) = alighting/way-station lodging. vwy's distinctive slice is the durative occupancy/residence of a place. Falsifiability: if any occurrence used a vwy-derivative for a momentary passing-through with no staying, or for an abstract state entirely detached from occupying a locus, the "durative settled residence" core would fail. No such occurrence exists in the data.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — durative settled residence/lodging — is surface-recoverable in all 14 occurrences with minimal inference. Twelve tokens are one lexeme (مَثْوَى) whose maf'al morphology transparently yields "place of residing"; the participle ثَاوِيًا (28:45) exposes the bare verbal residue "to reside/dwell" without any place-noun scaffolding, ruling out a purely locative reading; and the household-lodging tokens (12:21, 12:23) and the general مَثْوَىٰكُمْ (47:19) extend the same residence notion into hospitality/abode without breaking it. The direction is determinate (remaining-in-place, not merely being-located), and construction-internal evidence (خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا reinforcing the stay; مَأْوَى contrasted in 3:151) both fixes and sharpens the sense against its neighbors. Valence and duration are demonstrably supplied by other words (بِئْسَ, أَكْرِمِى, خَالِدِينَ), not by the root, so subtraction is clean. No occurrence resists the residue; hence PREFERRED at STRONG strength.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial sweep of all 14 occurrences found NO genuine failing token. The root ثوي is monosemous across the corpus: 13 tokens are the ism-makān مَثْوَى/مَثْوًى (place of abiding) and 1 is the active participle ثَاوِيًا (28:45, one residing). Every token reduces cleanly to the invariant 'settled remaining-in-place over time.' Hardest cases and resolutions: (a) Eschatological cluster (16:29, 29:68, 39:32/60/72, 3:151, 40:76, 41:24, 47:12, 6:128) — Fire/Hell as مَثْوَى could be dismissed as mere 'location,' but the recurring خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا (abiding therein) in 16:29/39:72/40:76/6:128 construction-internally spells out durative staying, confirming residence not momentary location. (b) 47:19 مَثْوَىٰكُمْ is explicitly contrasted with مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ (your moving-about) — resting/staying vs movement — which STRENGTHENS the durative-staying reading rather than threatening it. (c) 12:21/23 (Joseph's lodging in the Egyptian's house) are honorable domestic residence; 28:45 is bare verbal 'you were not a dweller among Midyan.' All fit. Neighbor-root contrast is decisively demonstrated in 3:151, where root أوي (مَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ = place of refuge/resort) and root ثوي (مَثْوَى = place of settled abiding) co-occur in ONE verse: أوى = seeking shelter/return-to; ثوي = prolonged settled staying. The contribution discriminates, is not over-broad, and is falsifiable (failure would require a token meaning momentary location or a non-residence homonym — none exists). Unity holds.
